name: What factors determine the cost of log cabin refinishing and repairs?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of log cabin refinishing and repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends on the home’s square footage, wall height, architectural complexity, current condition of the existing finish, and whether logs require full finish removal. A home that only requires light washing and a single clear topcoat costs substantially less than a structure requiring complete mechanical stripping, extensive chinking repair, and multi-coat restaining. Multi-story gables, dormers, and high rooflines also increase setup requirements, requiring additional staging, scaffolding, and safety rigging.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on cabin size, wall heights, existing finish condition, scaffolding requirements, and the amount of chinking repair needed.
